title: Second-Key Order Price
content:
**Billing calculation note — SSL/TLS Certificates: price of a second-key order.**

A second-key order is a further subscription of the same product, for the same common name and the same number of extra names as an active subscription the customer already holds (the sibling), ordered because another server needs its own key.

**1. Term.** A second-key order is placed only where the sibling runs at least one whole year from the order date. The second-key subscription then runs from the order date for the whole years from the order date to the sibling's subscription end date, at most the product's longest subscription term (3 years), so that it ends no later than the sibling. Where the sibling runs less than a whole year from the order date, no second-key order is priced or booked.

**2. Price components.** A second-key order is billed at the tier's price for those years plus the product's price per added name per year times the sibling's extra names times the years, rounded half up to the cent. In words:

- the **certificate price component** is the product's price for the term: the 1-year price for a one-year term, the 2-year price per year multiplied by 2 for a two-year term, or the 3-year price per year multiplied by 3 for a three-year term;
- the **extra-names component** is the product's price per added name per year, multiplied by the number of extra names the sibling records, multiplied by the years of the term.

**3. Assembly.** Every percentage reduction acts once on the price component of the second-key order it reduces, every multiplier of a name's yearly price acts on that yearly price, and the reduced amount, the sum of the price components, is rounded half up to the cent before any fixed credit is subtracted; the result is then rounded half up to the cent.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures).** A sibling records 7 extra names and ends 2 years and 4 months after the order date, so the second-key term is two whole years. Suppose, for illustration, a 2-year price per year of USD 41.70 and a price per added name per year of USD 13.37.

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Term | 2 years |
| Certificate price component | USD 41.70 multiplied by 2, USD 83.40 |
| Extra-names component | USD 13.37 multiplied by 7 names, then by 2 years, USD 187.18 |
| Sum of the price components, rounded half up | USD 270.58 |
| Second-key order price | USD 270.58 |

**Term boundary (hypothetical dates).** A sibling ending on 14 May 2033 gives an order placed on 14 May 2032 a term of one whole year; an order placed on 15 May 2032 finds the sibling running less than a whole year, and no second-key order is priced or booked.
